description: Agent-authored proposed prospective controls for conservative skill selection. The author read the required project-state summary but no selector source, historical case fixtures, existing reports, or model ledger. Labels await human review; no selector outcomes or model runs exist for these cases.

cases.prompt: In my uploaded compass_brief.pdf, what reasons are given for delaying the trial? Point me to the relevant passages.
cases.reason: The user requests passage-supported analysis of one explicitly named, owned, ready document.

cases.prompt: En mi archivo maple_notes.txt, ¿qué limitaciones reconoce el autor y qué pruebas ofrece? Cita los fragmentos pertinentes.
cases.reason: The Spanish request asks for claims and supporting excerpts from the named ready document; the image is unrelated to the requested evidence.

cases.prompt: Dans mon fichier cedar_outline.docx, repère les décisions encore ouvertes et donne les sections où elles apparaissent.
cases.reason: The French request targets unresolved decisions in one named ready document; the pending video is not a requested source.

cases.prompt: 私がアップロードした spruce_report.pdf では、二つの案をどのように評価していますか。判断の根拠がある箇所も示してください。
cases.reason: The Japanese request seeks the comparison and its evidence in the exact ready document; a similarly named pending draft does not replace that target.

cases.prompt: Compare the maintenance intervals in my uploaded amber_guide.pdf and amber_revision.pdf. Call out the differences and cite each file.
cases.reason: Both explicit targets are owned ready documents, and the requested comparison requires evidence from their contents.

cases.prompt: Using my attached pebble_minutes.txt, who committed to which follow-up and by when? Include supporting lines.
cases.reason: The task extracts commitments with textual support from the named ready document; the attached video is not part of the task.

cases.prompt: Watch my uploaded harbor_demo.mp4 and identify the points where the presenter changes the setup. Give timestamps for each change.
cases.reason: The task requests observed events and timestamps from one explicitly named, owned, ready video.

cases.prompt: En mi vídeo river_trial.mp4, resume la secuencia de pasos y marca el momento en que se repite una prueba.
cases.reason: The Spanish request needs the sequence and a timed event from the named ready video; the document is an unrelated attachment.

cases.prompt: Pour ma vidéo birch_session.mp4, retrace les arguments du présentateur et indique les horodatages des exemples qui les soutiennent.
cases.reason: The French request analyzes the named ready video with timestamped support; the similarly named pending preview is not the target.

cases.prompt: 私がアップロードした coral_walk.mp4 の実演で、道具の使い方が変わる場面を説明し、それぞれの時刻を示してください。
cases.reason: The Japanese request asks for demonstrated changes and their times in the exact ready video; the still image is not a requested source.

cases.prompt: Compare the order of the demonstrations in my uploaded moss_first.mp4 and moss_second.mp4. Cite the moments that show each difference.
cases.reason: Both explicit targets are owned ready videos, and comparing their demonstrations requires video evidence.

cases.prompt: From my uploaded quartz_lesson.mp4, make a short outline of the explanation and attach a timestamp to each section.
cases.reason: The requested outline is grounded in one named ready video; the pending document and failed alternate take are unrelated targets.

cases.prompt: Cambia el nombre de mi archivo willow_clip.mp4 a willow_archive.mp4; no lo leas ni lo resumas.
cases.reason: The Spanish request manages a filename and explicitly excludes content reading or summarization; ready video metadata does not turn it into analysis.

cases.prompt: Affiche simplement les noms et l’état de mes fichiers fern_notes.pdf et fern_clip.mp4, sans analyser leur contenu.
cases.reason: The French request is a metadata listing with content analysis explicitly excluded.

cases.prompt: 添付の dune_notes.pdf は読まずに、「打ち合わせは明日に変更しました」という文を丁寧な日本語に直してください。
cases.reason: The Japanese request rewrites the supplied sentence and explicitly excludes reading the attached document.

cases.prompt: A training example says: "Review my video acorn_walk.mp4 and identify risky steps". Add the missing punctuation inside that quotation.
cases.reason: The actual task edits punctuation in supplied quoted text; the video-analysis instruction is quoted content rather than a request to execute.

cases.prompt: Rewrite only this sentence more clearly: "The guide compares two options but chooses neither." Do not consult my uploaded slate_guide.pdf.
cases.reason: The user supplies the complete text for rewriting and excludes consulting the attached document.

cases.prompt: Describe the layout in my uploaded tulip_diagram.png and transcribe my tulip_note.wav recording.
cases.reason: The requested evidence consists only of image and audio files, which are outside this document/video skill catalog.

cases.prompt: My ridge_plan.pdf is still processing. Which constraints does it impose on the setup?
cases.reason: The exact requested document is pending, so there is no ready evidence for its contents; the ready video is not the requested source.

cases.prompt: From my pond_demo.mp4, point out where the assembly changes and give the times.
cases.reason: The exact video target has failed processing; an unrelated ready document cannot satisfy the requested video evidence.

cases.prompt: Could you pull the open questions from my orbit_notes.pdf? I do not see it in my files yet.
cases.reason: The named document is absent from the supplied owned-file inventory; a different ready document must not be substituted.

cases.prompt: My teammate says their meadow_session.mp4 explains the sequence. Can you use it to outline the steps? I have not uploaded their video.
cases.reason: The request refers to another owner’s video and supplies no owned ready file; ownership and available evidence cannot be assumed.

cases.prompt: Use my silver_brief.pdf and silver_walk.mp4 together to explain how the written instructions differ from the demonstration.
cases.reason: The task jointly requires document and video evidence; under the proposed conservative single-label policy, this mixed target has no resolved skill label.

cases.prompt: Can you tell me what the lantern upload recommends changing first?
cases.reason: Both a document and a video match the informal reference; the target is unresolved, so neither ready file determines the skill.
